why: Build step for judgment slice E87 of the Effect-check sweep (missingPipeableSignature in libfabrika's runtime, cloudflare, processes, settings and ledger folders), in next/, under the owner ruling that every hit gets Function.dual with data-first callers unchanged. Recounted at 33765f0 merged with origin/main, with only this check at error through --lspconfig on next/packages/libfabrika/tsconfig.json, nothing written to a tsconfig: 82 product hits (runtime 18, cloudflare 25, processes 17, settings 13, ledger 9), 0 in exam paths. Fixed 79: 65 by a scratch codemod (not committed) that wraps a fixed-arity export in Function.dual with written overload types, 12 of them given a written return type they lacked and 7 keeping their body under a private <name>Body const typed by ReturnType (16 such consts in all), 6 by a second scratch codemod for functions with optional arguments, and 8 by hand. Every overload pair puts the piped form first and the data-first form last, so Parameters<typeof f> and ReturnType<typeof f> still read the data-first form. A function with an optional argument decides by a predicate on its first argument: a Durable Object state has storage (connectionLayer, connectionRuntime, projectLayer, processLayer), a Sql has exec (accountingEntries, ledgerStore), the platform loader has a get function (workerLoader; the test fakes give only get), and recordedLayer, once an overloaded function declaration, reads a piped call by its first argument being an Effect. sameReason wraps Schema.toEquivalence in Function.dual(2). Generic functions without a written return type use an instantiation expression, ReturnType<typeof makeBody<I, S, E>>, and put the generics their piped form cannot know on the returned function (ObjectService.make, Chunk.input). Left 3, whose first argument is unknown, so no predicate on it can tell a direct call from a piped one: ExitReason.ts:52 decodeExitReason and Mailbox.ts:117 letterBody (Schema decoders taking input and optional ParseOptions) and Execution.ts:252 nodeExecution (declared: unknown, build = "node"; a string declaration called alone would read as piped). Sent back to tests: src/ledger/Ledger.types.test.ts lines 21 to 24 read expectTypeOf(LedgerSql.layer).parameters and .returns, which expect-type takes over every overload, so a dual layer fails them; the law needs the data-first form named, for example expectTypeOf<Parameters<typeof LedgerSql.layer>>().
